origin: midpoint of sole contact anchors atY0; toe boxes extend forward; no global root rotation/scale
bind_pose: slight A-pose mirrored aroundX=0; mesh part frames may rotate but all joint bind frames remain runtime-XYZ identity
bevel_policy: 8mm maximum single-step, flat primary faces; no organic head or separate spherical joint pads

vest_envelope.construction_note: Volumetric V-neck layer derived from shirt; nominal10mm X/Z clearance, no coplanar cloth faces.

mitten_L.construction_note: Squared palm/thumb envelope; later.045m grip notch for.040m bar; no thin finger rods.

mitten_R.construction_note: Squared palm/thumb envelope; later.045m grip notch for.040m bar; no thin finger rods.

anchor_seat_contact.purpose: future seat plane normal+Y/forward+Z; not a vehicle fit acceptance

role_policy: Tint only vest/headwear per instance, dark base clothes shared. Codes01..05 are role design codes, not actor IDs. Do not globally recolor or add people on role change.

proposed_cart_interface.authority: R11 dimensions target; handleZ and attach relationship require later cart approval
proposed_cart_interface.pose_status: reach screen only; neutral hands do not already hold these targets

seated_interface.future_seated_origin_rule: subtract seat contact from body frame and solve folded legs; never mount standing floor root directly on seat

screen_pose.scope: Declared skeletal transform only; actual vehicle seated fit deferred

cart_reach_screen.scope: Necessary reach/limit screen, not actual IK/rig or collision proof

seat_fold_screen.scope: Declared skeletal transform only; actual vehicle seated fit deferred

deferred_checks: Actual bevels/joins in four source and browser views
